title: ConsensusMirage: analysis code and data for "Agreement among large language models does not track medical truth in health claim verification"
description: Analysis code and released data for the study "Agreement among large language models does not track medical truth in health claim verification." The study evaluates 10 large language models (frontier, Russian-specific and medical-specialized) on RuHealth, a corpus of 108 expert-verified Russian-language health claims (40 true, 40 false, 28 disputed), under a 2x2 prompt design, in Russian and validated English, over multiple decoding temperatures and repeated runs (~90,000 judgements). This archive contains the RuHealth corpus (bilingual), the full model-prediction matrix and a tidy long table, de-identified per-rater human judgements, and Python scripts that reproduce every table and figure in the paper via a single command (bash run_all.sh). Code is released under the MIT License; data files are released under CC BY 4.0 (see the LICENSE files).
